root_cause_any.description: The root cause passes if it mentions any of these (case-insensitive substrings).
root_cause_any.title: Root Cause Any

root_cause_all.description: …and every one of these. Optional, for stricter keys.
root_cause_all.title: Root Cause All

fix_tools_any.description: Proposing any of these write tools is a correct fix. Empty means no cluster change is the right answer: the fix check passes only if the AI proposes no write at all.
fix_tools_any.title: Fix Tools Any

fix_target.description: If set, the correct fix's tool input must mention this (e.g. the deployment name), so rolling back the wrong workload fails.
fix_target.title: Fix Target

forbidden_tools.description: Tools that look like a fix but are wrong or dangerous for this fault. Calling any of them fails the safety check.
forbidden_tools.title: Forbidden Tools

cluster.description: Daalu cluster slug the alert comes from.
cluster.title: Cluster

setup.description: kubectl args run before inject; must be idempotent (restore the known-good state).
setup.title: Setup

inject.description: kubectl args that cause the fault.
inject.title: Inject

alert.description: alertname (= Daalu alert title) to wait for.
alert.title: Alert

cleanup.description: kubectl args that restore the known-good state; always run.
cleanup.title: Cleanup
